Frequently Asked Questions

  • Do I need good credit? — No. This seminar is specifically for people who've been told no by banks.
  • Is this really free? — Yes, 100% free. No catch. We provide the training, breakfast, and giveaways at no cost to you.
  • Do I need money saved? — Not to attend. But if you're ready to buy, having some savings helps. We'll explain everything at the event.
  • Can I bring someone? — Absolutely. Bring your spouse, partner, or anyone who'd benefit from learning about this.
  • What if I can't make it? — Join our free Facebook group to stay in the loop for future events.

One or more managing members hold an active real estate license in Oklahoma. This is not financial advice, nor are we acting as financial advisors. Home Run Homes is a matchmaking service connecting buyers with owner-financed properties. Always read agreements before signing and consult with appropriate professionals.
